solver_seed.description: Fixed solver seed so every demo run is reproducible.

solver_time_limit_s.description: CP-SAT wall-clock limit. On expiry the deterministic greedy fallback runs and the response is labelled FALLBACK.

exposure_w_facilities.description: Share of exposure driven by critical facilities (school, clinic, anganwadi).

exposure_w_households.description: Share of exposure driven by household count.

exposure_w_population.description: Share of exposure driven by resident population.

history_radius_m.description: Radius around a habitation within which historical incidents are counted.

vuln_w_elderly.description: Share of residents aged 60 and above.

vuln_w_kutcha_share.description: Structural typology proxy: kutcha and semi-pucca dwelling share.

vuln_w_low_income.description: Share of single-earner or low-income households.

w_exposure.description: Weight on population and critical-facility exposure.

w_hazard.description: Weight on composite hazard sampled over the habitation footprint.

w_vulnerability.description: Weight on the demographic vulnerability index.

min_reliability_threshold.description: Route reliability below which a site is treated as infeasible for a habitation in the optimiser, not merely penalised.

GenerationConfig.description:
Assumptions behind the synthetic habitation and site records.

These are ASTRA demonstration assumptions for a Himalayan hill district, not
measured statistics. They are exposed here, with a DEMO_CONFIG chip on every
value, precisely so that "where did your 12 percent elderly come from?" has a
visible answer rather than a defensive one. Habitation placement and size are
calibrated to real terrain, land cover, road access and the WorldPop
population surface; the demographic composition below is assumed.

NormalisationConfig.description:
Bounds that turn a physical measurement into a 0-1 factor value.

A weighted overlay is only meaningful if each factor is normalised on a
stated scale. These are the stated scales. Each pair is a linear ramp: at or
below ``low`` the factor contributes 0, at or above ``high`` it contributes
1, and inverted factors (where less is worse) ramp the other way. The bounds
are ASTRA choices, informed by the observed range in the corridor, and every
one of them is visible in the transparency panel.

Mean catchment slope contributing nothing to flash-flood susceptibility.

Elevation at or below which coastal exposure is saturated.

info.description:
ASTRA - Proactive Settlement Risk & Relocation Intelligence.

Every red-zone boundary, capacity figure and priority ranking in ASTRA is produced by a documented, auditable formula or a constraint solver. AI is used only to explain those outputs in plain language, never to produce them.

Decision-support output. Final relocation decisions rest with the SDMA /
District Authority. Habitation and candidate-site records in the demonstration
scenario are synthetic and terrain-calibrated, and are not an official hazard
designation of any real settlement.
